# Vendored last30days Runtime

- Source: https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill
- Version: 3.18.4
- Commit: `52f53312ff2f272e16bbc1785e1c04f9d9c19b31`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

This directory contains only the executable research engine and its runtime
modules. Agent-skill manifests, documentation, fixtures, tests, release tooling,
and host-specific integrations are intentionally excluded.

The vendored source preserves the upstream runtime behavior. Non-English API
constants required by specific sources are represented with Unicode escapes so
the source files remain English-only.
